diplomaticos-cuba--linea-clasica.description: Diplomáticos dates from the 1960s and closely resembles Montecristo, naming its sizes by number rather than by name. Made entirely by hand with long filler, it uses wrapper and filler from the Vuelta Abajo in Pinar del Río. The No. 2 pirámide, medium to full, moves from toasted nuts and cocoa through cinnamon and honey to pepper and bitter chocolate.

thirds.notes: Toasted pecan and cocoa with crisp pepper, a mineral edge, leather and a faint cedar.
Spice comes in: cinnamon, a salted-caramel sweetness, walnut and white pepper, with vanilla behind.
Black pepper, oak and bitter cocoa, with peanut and, for some, a soft mocha sweetness.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Diplomáticos No. 2 review
